lock_review: Context snapshot and transitions use the same Context monitor; removed AdmissionHandle guards remain in beginPlacement under this monitor.
Endpoint resource mutation is serialized under the role-local lock. Current cleanup and status paths release it before Lifecycle callbacks.
Prefill prediction runs outside the resource lock and rechecks exact surviving members before commit.
Scheduler releases its lock before installing endpoint queue observers; retirement completion runs callbacks outside its monitor.
Task registration/queue lane locks are released before running request work; deadline registration lock is released before Context callbacks.

findings.status: Static visibility risk; stale read not reproduced
findings.finding: queueWait is an ordinary mutable Supplier reference; observeQueueWait writes it under resourceLock, but getLatestQueueWaitSnapshot reads without that lock or a volatile read of this field.
findings.trigger: EndpointWork is installed after endpoint publication; timeout diagnostics can read concurrently, including while route placement is in progress. The read entry does not establish a publication guarantee for this supplier.
findings.impact: A timeout diagnostic may use the initial/default supplier instead of the installed observer. No evidence of ledger corruption or scheduling changes; this supplier is used for diagnostics only.
findings.recommended_change: Make queueWait volatile, retaining the existing lock-free diagnostic read. admissionBlock is read under resourceLock and does not require the same change.

limits: Passing bounded tests does not prove absence of every Java data race or deadlock.

Thread.print reports observed monitor/ownable-synchronizer cycles; it does not establish absence of task/future self-waits or all virtual-thread stalls. Completion/timeout assertions cover the exercised paths only.
RPC uses Java mock engines, not production inference engines; replacement implementations are outside the executed default-component paths.
No production changes; prior 750P/750D performance evidence retained and not rerun under thread sampling.

test_classes.coverage: A real status-reduction thread pauses in prediction; a second thread releases one/all members, replaces the request id with a new exact route, or retires the endpoint; a third reads stats. Mutation must finish before prediction resumes; assert current work, no stale ownership resurrection and zero final resources.

100 iterations each of cancellation-first, send-first and simultaneous actors, plus concurrent snapshot reads. Assert legal send result, monotonic cancellation, blocked acknowledgement after cancellation, no second send and unchanged old snapshots.

20 repetitions: eight writers publish 400 notifications while the first cleanup is blocked; close admission, resume, assert latest state applied, at most one cleanup actor and drained shutdown. Two additional cases verify an ordinary/stop owner can submit its own continuation during shutdown while unrelated work is rejected.
